sql.label: The article
sql.statement: SELECT lang, page_id, rev_id, wikidata_id, title, date_modified FROM article WHERE lang = ? AND page_id = ?

sql.label: Has history
sql.statement: SELECT rev_id, user, row_start AS saved_at FROM article_history WHERE page_id = ?

sql.label: Paragraphs needing attention
sql.statement: SELECT s.para_id, s.badge, s.badge_label, s.badge_reasons, s.review_reasons, s.attention, p.kind, p.section, p.text, p.citations FROM paragraph_signal s JOIN paragraph p ON p.lang = s.lang AND p.page_id = s.page_id AND p.para_id = s.para_id WHERE s.lang = ? AND s.page_id = ? AND s.attention > 0 ORDER BY s.attention DESC, s.para_id ASC

sql.label: Counterpart paragraphs with no match here
sql.statement: SELECT g.lang, g.para_id, g.nearest_similarity, p.section, p.text FROM coverage_gap g JOIN paragraph p ON p.lang = g.lang AND p.page_id = g.page_id AND p.para_id = g.para_id WHERE g.fi_page_id = ? ORDER BY g.nearest_similarity ASC, g.lang, g.para_id LIMIT ?
